title: EventBus multi-owner failure rotation recovery contract

contract.multi_owner_failure_isolation: Multiple failing listener callbacks do not abort or poison EventBus broadcast cycles
contract.failure_rotation_recovery: Different failing owners can be selectively removed and re-registered across successive broadcast cycles
contract.broadcast_continuity: All registered listeners continue receiving each emitted event exactly once
contract.duplicate_idempotency: Repeated registration during recovery does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.registry_integrity: Listener registry remains structurally valid after rotating failure and recovery ownership
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful across all observed failure rotation cycles
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, re-registration, and emit operations require the events permission
